lines: A cleric joke is like medicine. If it tastes pleasant, check it twice.
I told the brewing stand a joke. It is still working through it.
My remedies cure many things, though never bad timing.
The patient asked for something sweet, so I gave them good news.
I made a potion for patience. Nobody waited to try it.
The bottles never complain about my singing. They only crack.
A farmer asked whether beetroot counts as medicine. I prescribed soup.
My best cure for sleeplessness is explaining bottle storage.
I tried to read an omen in the smoke. The window was closed.
The cat knocked over a tonic and has looked healthier ever since.
A good healer keeps spirits up. Mine usually need corks.
I wrote down a brilliant joke, then used the paper as a label.
Someone asked for a love potion. I offered clean clothes and courage.
The brewing stand and I have an agreement. Neither of us dances.
I can cure a headache, unless my joke caused it.
A villager wanted stronger medicine. I handed them a smaller spoon.
My shelves are perfectly organized until I need something.
I prayed for a sign and the kettle boiled over.
The bitter part is medicinal. The face you make is for morale.
I know a joke about redstone, but the timing circuit failed.
